title: Automate onboarding: Lyra-14b v1.0 perf profiles, metadata, and changelog generation
author: Ellen Park
ci_details: build: pass; lint: pass; unit-tests: pass; perf-profiles: pass (retry 1); integration-tests: pass; changelog-generation: pass
description: Adds an automated onboarding pipeline for Lyra-14b v1.0 that generates performance profiles, validated metadata, and a changelog entry as part of model-registry CI. Motivation: eliminate manual steps during model releases, ensure perf profiles are reproducible and stored alongside metadata, and guarantee changelogs are generated consistently for release drafts. Changes include: new CI workflow (.github/workflows/onboard-model.yml) that coordinates benchmark-lab runs and artifacts upload; a perf harness wrapper (benchmarks/lyra/run_lyra_profiles.py) to standardize profile generation; metadata Jinja template and generated metadata (models/lyra/metadata.yaml.j2 and models/lyra/metadata/lyra-14b-v1.0.yaml); performance profiles (models/lyra/perf/lyra-14b-v1.0.json); changelog automation (tools/changelog/generate_changelog.py) which produces a release-ready entry and adds it to drafts; unit and integration tests for the generator and validation scripts. Checklist: [x] perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab CI [x] metadata validated against schema [x] changelog entry auto-created and included in release draft [x] unit tests for generator [ ] e2e verification on Dedicated staging. Related Linear: ENG-4782. Docs: https://redwood-internal/docs/model-registry/onboarding. Note: The onboarding flow is backward-compatible with existing scripts; no breaking API changes expected.
